evidence.detail: The class owns a CopyOnWriteArrayList of ScheduledTaskDescriptor records and exposes add/remove/read-only-list operations.
Its scheduler loop compares Instant.now() against each descriptor's last trigger using annotation amount + ChronoUnit, updates the trigger time and executes due work.
Due tasks run either by submitting to injected ScheduledExecutorService when the annotation async flag is set or synchronously via Runnable/reflection otherwise.
ClientApplicationBootstrap/Module provide this singleton scheduler service, and the live plugin manager is its only task-family consumer.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the singleton plugin scheduled-task registry and trigger runner.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/y/a is a runtime method annotation exposing interval amount, ChronoUnit, and an async/executor flag.
The live plugin manager rs/s/g scans plugin methods for this annotation, creates one rs/y/b descriptor per annotated method, and registers it with rs/y/c.
Plugin start adds these scheduled methods and plugin stop removes their associated descriptors, proving this annotation is the scheduler entry-point contract.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 annotation name for plugin methods scheduled by the live plugin manager.

evidence.detail: The class stores the ScheduledTask annotation, reflective Method, target plugin/object, optional Runnable lambda, and last-trigger Instant.
rs/s/g constructs this descriptor for each annotated plugin method and logs 'Scheduled task {}' before registering it with rs/y/c.
rs/y/c reads the descriptor's interval metadata, last-trigger Instant and Runnable/Method target to decide when and how to execute it.
